meta.name: Dupahiya 2025
meta.description:
Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

Rated TV-14 · Returning Series · First aired 7 Mar 2025 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Bombay Film Cartel · Network: Prime Video

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/9 (missing E8) | S2 8/8

videos.title: Bambai
videos.overview: Welcome to Dhadakpur, a one-of-a-kind Crime-Free village. Jha family is eager for their daughter, Roshni, to get married. Her choice of groom demands a never-seen- before bike as dowry. In spite of all odds, the Jha family is determined. The bike arrives amisdst celebration in the day but disaster strikes at night! The bike is stolen! Only 8 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Chor Nahi Chikaar
videos.overview: Banwari discovers the bike has been stolen! Bhugol and Teepu cook up a story casting suspicion on Amavas. The Sarpanch reaches Dhadakpur with good news. Banwari and Roshni question the prime suspect. Sparks fly between the two ex-lovers as they reminisce about their past. Roshni and Banwari return with no leads. Only 7 days left for wedding!

videos.title: Oh Mere Jija Ji
videos.overview: Amavas decides to fulfill his duty of being a good ex-lover. Kuber arrives in Dhadakpur to check out his beloved bike. Banwari enlists Pandit and Bhugol's help to ensure Kuber is left in a tizzy. Madan discovers Jha family's secret. Banwari decides to do the unthinkable. Only 6 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Kanoon Ke Haath
videos.overview: ASI Mithlesh suspects something is amiss in Dhadakpur. He awakens from his slumber when he discovers it has something to do with his old nemesis Banwari. Amavas puts forth his plan at the village meeting. Madan is nabbed and taken to the police station. Amavas and Bhugol set off on a journey to save Dhadakpur's pride and Roshni's wedding. Only 5 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Piyo Magar Pyaar Se
videos.overview: Sarpanch questions Pushpalata about the rumours he's heard . Relatives arrive for the wedding festivities. Roshni begins to have doubts. Durlabh instigates Kuber to verify if the bike has truly been bought. Amavas shares his vulnerable side with Bhugol as they gulp down a few drinks and pass out while the second hand bike stands ready to be collected. Only 4 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Ullu Mat Bolna
videos.overview: Bhugol and Amavas have to perform at a special birthday party to pay for the bike. Roshni confronts Kuber. Madan finally gets his dream job but is in a moral dilemma. Frustrated Banwari reaches the cop station. Pushpalata announces a strict punishment at the village meeting. Teepu helps Nirmal with the cash for her treatment. Only 3 days left for the wedding!

videos.title: Ulta Chor Kotwal Ko Dante
videos.overview: Mithlesh sets out to find the thief with renewed vigor. Amavas and Bhugol escape from Parmanu's clutches. Amavas is not impressed with Kuber. Pushpalata considers resigning. Mithlesh's investigation leads him to a suspect but just then Teepu reveals important evidence. Roshni's dilemma builds. Only 2 day left for the wedding!

videos.title: Atmanirbhar
videos.overview: The day of reckoning. Nirmal speaks to Pushpalata about the boycott. Kuber arrives with the wedding party at the Jha household but there is no sign of the bike. The wedding is in jeopardy! Mithlesh nabs the thief- but there is a bigger mastermind at play. Dhadakpur learns an important lesson that has a lasting impact. Bhugol manages to finally fulfill his dream!

videos.title: AG OG Lo Ji 5G
videos.overview: The winter winds bring new chaos to Dhadakpur! Roshni struggles with her SSC prep, Bhugol seeks divine intervention to become a hero and Banwari's hopes come crashing down with a 5G mobile tower! Amavas once again arrives with a scheme for Roshni- will she succumb to a short cut? It's 7 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Gurudakshina
videos.overview: Banwari is determined to get the mobile tower up- by hook or by crook. Bhugol picks Roshni to champion her dreams, only to get pulled into a risky scheme. Amavas spirals as he fumbles with a girl who likes him. Mithlesh zeroes in on his next big case. It's 6 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Hastakshar
videos.overview: Mithlesh's investigation leads him to Pratham Kumar, closing in on the scam. The Jha family's risky efforts finally pay off-and Banwari hands Roshni the precious fees. But just as things seem to fall into place, Pushpalata discovers that the Jha family has stabbed her in the back! It's 5 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Khaki Wala Gunda
videos.overview: Banwari's tower work sparks a village showdown as Pushpalata leads a dramatic protest. Bhugol senses the tension between Amavas and Roshni isn't just about the exam. Mithlesh uncovers a deeper nexus in the cheating scam. Roshni is set to collect the paper-but chaos erupts at a midnight raid. It's 4 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Prem Tribhuj
videos.overview: Mithlesh gets his hands on a crucial clue. Desperate to get the villagers and Pushpalata off his land, Banwari turns to an unlikely ally. Bhugol is convinced there's a love triangle brewing, even as Amavas takes a deadly risk for Roshni. Meanwhile, Mithlesh connects the dots and inches closer. It's 3 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Double Engine
videos.overview: Mithlesh recruits Bhugol, Roshni, and Amavas for a risky undercover mission. Bhugol secretly plots his escape to Mumbai. Meanwhile, Pushpalata flips the power game in a dramatic fashion. At Gyan Buniyaad, Roshni is introduced to her "bogie." Just 2 days to go for Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Bloody Beauty
videos.overview: Roshni comes face-to-face with Kuber-he humiliates her, but she won't back down. The mission is now colored with revenge. Banwari is arrested; Bhugol breaks, then does the unthinkable to save him. Mithlesh is sidelined. The Dupahiya is found-but completely dismantled. A few hours to go before Roshni's exam!

videos.title: Pareeksha
videos.overview: Roshni and Bhugol reach the exam center; Kuber refuses to enter without the Dupahiya. Chaos erupts, but Mithlesh finally gets his hands on the mastermind. Bhugol and Banwari resolve their differences, while Pushpalata's confidence in winning the upcoming election is threatened-just as tension between Roshni and Amavas rises
